evidence_policy.unit_assignment: No photo assigned to B1-1502 or any room without an identified tower/unit link.
evidence_policy.geometry: Construction photos support qualitative exterior details, not room dimensions, wall/slab thickness, balcony radius, ceiling height or door topology.
evidence_policy.finishes: Unfinished concrete and green construction mesh are not evidence of finished apartment materials. Agreement Annexure F remains the finish authority.
evidence_policy.marketing_models: Photos of a physical sales model show planned context and cannot establish built geometry or as-built finishes.

model_findings.finding: Exterior photos show continuous smooth curved concrete bands. The reconstructed main balcony uses a coarse polygon profile with an inferred outer arc.
model_findings.supported_action: A smoother presentation of the existing inferred profile is supported, retaining agreement span/average depth and recording any interpolation.
model_findings.limit: The photos do not establish an exact radius or confirm that the photographed tower/unit is B1-1502.

model_findings.finding: Actual construction shows stacked slabs, overhead balcony soffits and vertical concrete piers; a standalone cutaway omits this exterior context.
model_findings.supported_action: Use the photos as qualitative guidance for slab edges, soffits and vertical context when those views are represented.
model_findings.limit: Keep cutaway presentation distinct from the building exterior. Dimensions and structural positions require architectural elevation/section or identified measured references.

model_findings.finding: Facade openings sit within substantial concrete wall strips and recesses, rather than appearing as unsupported thin surfaces.
model_findings.supported_action: Review exterior opening framing/recess detail against the primary plan; represent any unmeasured detailing as an assumption.
model_findings.limit: The visible openings cannot be assigned to a particular B1-1502 bedroom or washroom, and exact depth/window sizes cannot be measured from these photos.

model_findings.finding: Neither unfinished facade concrete nor the sales model verifies finished apartment floors, railings, cabinetry or furniture.
model_findings.supported_action: Retain agreement-specified finish categories and explicitly label exact colors/textures/fixture models illustrative.
model_findings.limit: Do not replace specified glass balcony railing with a solid concrete guard solely from an unfinished edge band; its structural/guard role is not established.
